cards.originalTitle: Self-Evolving Multi-Agent Symbolic Discovery for Financial Fundamental Analysis
cards.whyItMattersEn: In financial fundamental analysis, black-box models offer limited interpretability while pure symbolic regression struggles with multiple perspectives and non-stationarity. This framework attempts to improve valuation performance while producing interpretable equations, and it releases distilled evolutionary learnings and context-dependent strategy weights that may support future research.
cards.summaryEn: The paper argues that financial valuation differs from natural science: it admits multiple valid perspectives, operates under non-stationary conditions, and relies on noisy continuous feedback, which limits conventional symbolic regression. The authors propose MUFASA, a hierarchical multi-agent framework with perspective-specific agents, a meta-coordinator for market-context reasoning, and a memory mechanism over statistical performance summaries. They report that across datasets from multiple countries MUFASA outperforms classical finance methods, financial large language models, and symbolic regression approaches on valuation, while releasing interpretable equations and distilled learnings.
cards.limitations: 论文结论基于作者选取的多国数据集与特定估值任务，未说明是否覆盖全部市场环境或资产类型；所报告的优越性来自作者实验设置，尚未经独立复现验证；公开的方程、蒸馏学习与策略权重为研究性产物，不构成投资建议或可直接部署的估值工具；金融市场的结构变化可能使已发现方程与策略权重随时间失效。
cards.descriptionEn: This work brings symbolic regression into financial valuation via a hierarchical multi-agent framework, MUFASA, which addresses multiple valid perspectives and non-stationary markets through perspective decomposition, meta-coordination and memory. Its value lies in producing interpretable equations alongside cross-market learning artifacts.
cards.description: 该工作将符号回归引入金融估值场景，提出分层多智能体框架MUFASA，通过视角分解、元协调与记忆机制应对金融符号发现的多解性与非平稳性。其价值在于同时产出可解释方程与跨市场可用的学习产物。
keyPointsEn: MUFASA disentangles equation discovery across specialized agents representing distinct valuation perspectives, coordinated hierarchically by a meta-coordinator.
A memory mechanism reasons over statistical summaries such as accuracy, stability, and tail risk to guide learning under noisy feedback.

In experiments across datasets from multiple countries, the authors report state-of-the-art valuation performance versus classical finance methods, financial large language models, and symbolic regression approaches.
cards.titleEn: Multi-Agent Symbolic Discovery Framework Improves Financial Fundamental Valuation
cards.limitationsEn: The conclusions rest on the authors' selected multi-country datasets and a specific valuation task, without stating coverage of all market environments or asset classes; the reported superiority comes from the authors' experimental setup and has not yet been independently replicated; the released equations, distilled learnings, and strategy weights are research artifacts, not investment advice or deployable valuation tools; structural market changes may render discovered equations and strategy weights ineffective over time.
keyPoints: MUFASA将方程发现分解为多个代表不同估值视角的专用智能体，并由元协调器进行分层推理。
记忆机制基于准确率、稳定性和尾部风险等统计摘要，在噪声反馈下指导学习。
在多国数据集实验中，作者报告其估值表现优于经典金融方法、金融大语言模型与符号回归方法。
cards.title: 多智能体符号发现框架提升财务基本面估值
cards.summary: 论文指出，金融估值与自然科学不同：存在多种有效视角、市场条件非平稳、反馈信号含噪且连续，这使传统符号回归受限。作者提出MUFASA，一种分层多智能体框架，包含视角专用智能体、对市场上下文进行分层推理的元协调器，以及基于统计表现摘要的记忆机制。作者报告在多国数据集上，MUFASA在估值任务上优于经典金融方法、金融大语言模型和符号回归方法，并公开可解释方程与演化迭代中的蒸馏学习结果。
cards.whyItMatters: 金融基本面分析中，黑箱模型难以提供可解释的估值逻辑，而纯符号回归又常受多视角与非平稳性困扰。该框架尝试在保持可解释方程的同时提升估值表现，并公开演化学习结果与情境相关策略权重，可能为后续研究提供可复用的中间产物。

cards.originalTitle: From Word Counts to Context: Topic Models for Asset Pricing
cards.whyItMattersEn: If context-aware topic models can improve construction of systematic risk factors, they may enhance how text signals are used in asset pricing; however, current evidence is insufficient for practical deployment.
cards.summaryEn: Facts: The authors use 394,661 articles and an identical downstream portfolio pipeline, varying only the text layer (model, text length, term ranking) to compare LDA with a frozen sentence transformer plus k-means. The sentence transformer branch shows higher observed NPMI coherence and Sharpe ratios, but available tests do not establish outperformance. Author view: context-aware techniques are promising, but stricter tests and broader datasets are needed to increase confidence.
cards.limitations: 可用检验未建立统计显著优越性；探索性设定使用球形聚类和多期限暴露，可能引入事后选择；作者指出需仅用各时点可得信息并扩展数据集以增强置信度。
cards.descriptionEn: Using the same news corpus and portfolio construction pipeline, the study compares sentence-transformer k-means against LDA for topic coherence and resulting Sharpe ratios, offering new evidence on text-based risk factor construction.
cards.description: 该研究在相同新闻文本与组合构建流程下，比较句向量器加k-means与LDA生成主题词表的一致性及对应组合的夏普比率，为文本风险因子构建提供新证据。
keyPointsEn: Under the same corpus and portfolio pipeline, the sentence transformer plus k-means shows higher observed topic coherence and Sharpe ratios than LDA.
In exploratory specifications (spherical clustering and multi-horizon exposures), the combined model has an observed excess-return Sharpe of 1.03.
The authors see promise in context-aware methods, but current tests do not establish statistically significant outperformance.
cards.titleEn: Contextual Topic Models for Asset Pricing: Sentence Transformers vs. LDA
cards.limitationsEn: Available tests do not establish statistically significant outperformance; exploratory specifications using spherical clustering and multi-horizon exposures may introduce ex-post selection; the authors note that using only information available at each date and broader datasets is needed to enhance confidence.
keyPoints: 在相同文本集合和组合构建流程下，句向量器加k-means在主题一致性和组合夏普比率上观测值高于LDA。
探索性设定（球形聚类与多期限暴露）下，合并模型的观测超额收益夏普比率为1.03。
作者认为语境感知方法有前景，但现有检验未确立统计显著的超额表现。
cards.title: 语境化主题模型在资产定价中的探索：句向量与LDA对比
cards.summary: 事实：作者用394,661篇文章和相同下游组合构建流程，仅改变文本层（模型、文本长度、主题词排序），比较LDA与冻结句向量器加k-means。结果显示句向量分支在NPMI一致性和夏普比率上观测值更高，但可用检验未确立其优越性。作者观点：语境感知技术有前景，但需更严格检验和更广数据集来增强置信度。
cards.whyItMatters: 若语境感知主题模型能提升系统性风险因子的构建质量，可能改善文本信号在资产定价中的使用方式；但当前证据尚不足以支持实际部署。

cards.originalTitle: RICE-Alpha: Reliability-Informed Correction with Event Graphs for LLM-Agent Stock Forecasting
cards.whyItMattersEn: If historical event continuation provides incremental information after point-in-time grounding and reliability calibration, LLM financial agents can more systematically use issuer-specific event timing rather than only retrieving news text; the residual correction framing also helps distinguish historical event signals from existing forecast signals.
cards.summaryEn: The authors argue that equity-relevant news evolves through temporally dependent corporate events, so historical information is useful only when event continuity, information availability, and transition reliability are modeled; existing LLM financial agents offer limited support for issuer-specific chronology under point-in-time constraints and for identifying incremental information from historical transitions. RICE-Alpha separates a history-aware multi-view Base Alpha from a reliability-calibrated residual correction derived from historical event continuation, using a multi-tier memory layer and a typed event agent that forms successor relations within issuers and pools across firms only after valid local pairing. On daily Nasdaq-100 and Hang Seng Index panels from 2024 to 2026, the authors report the strongest results among evaluated LLM-based agents and momentum across four predictive and four portfolio metrics, with ICIR more than doubling the strongest baseline and net Sharpe ratios of 1.656 and 1.725 in the U.S. and Hong Kong; U.S. ablations show significant reductions in IC and RankIC after Holm adjustment when major components are removed.
cards.limitations: 证据来自作者在2024至2026年纳斯达克100与恒生指数日度面板上的回测与消融，不能直接外推到其他市场、频率或时期；事件配对、可靠性校准与残差化依赖建模选择，其稳健性需独立复现；净夏普等组合指标可能受交易成本、容量与实现细节影响；本文不构成投资建议。
cards.descriptionEn: This work introduces RICE-Alpha, which incorporates issuer-specific historical event evolution and reliability calibration into an LLM stock-scoring pipeline and adds it as a residual correction to a multi-view base forecast. Its value lies in imposing point-in-time compliance, event continuity, and transition reliability constraints on historical event information, with reported gains in predictive and portfolio evaluations.
cards.description: 该工作提出RICE-Alpha，将发行人特定历史事件演化与可靠性校准纳入LLM股票评分流程，并以残差修正方式叠加在多视角基准预测上。其价值在于为历史事件信息引入时点合规、事件延续与转移可靠性约束，从而在评测中提升预测与组合表现。
keyPointsEn: The framework separates a multi-view Base Alpha from a reliability-calibrated residual correction derived from historical event continuation, forming the RICE Delta.
A multi-tier memory layer grounds point-in-time issuer-specific history, while a typed event agent pairs successors within issuers before pooling across firms.
On 2024–2026 Nasdaq-100 and Hang Seng Index panels, the authors report ICIR more than doubling the strongest baseline and net Sharpe ratios of 1.656 and 1.725.
cards.titleEn: RICE-Alpha: Reliability-Calibrated Event Graphs for LLM-Agent Stock Forecasting
cards.limitationsEn: Evidence comes from the authors' backtests and ablations on 2024–2026 daily Nasdaq-100 and Hang Seng Index panels and may not generalize to other markets, frequencies, or periods; event pairing, reliability calibration, and residualization depend on modeling choices whose robustness requires independent replication; portfolio metrics such as net Sharpe may be affected by transaction costs, capacity, and implementation details; this is not investment advice.
keyPoints: 框架将多视角Base Alpha与由历史事件延续得到的可靠性校准残差修正分离，形成RICE Delta。
多层记忆层用于时点合规的发行人特定历史，类型化事件代理在发行人内配对后再跨公司汇总后继关系。
在2024至2026年纳斯达克100与恒生指数面板上，作者报告ICIR超过最强基线两倍以上，净夏普分别为1.656与1.725。
cards.title: RICE-Alpha：用事件图与可靠性校准修正LLM股票预测
cards.summary: 作者认为，股票相关新闻通过时间相关企业事件演化，历史信息只有在建模事件连续性、信息可得性与转移可靠性时才有用；现有LLM金融代理对时点约束下的发行人特定时间顺序与历史转移增量信息支持有限。RICE-Alpha将历史感知的多视角Base Alpha与基于历史事件延续的可靠性校准残差修正分离，通过多层记忆层与类型化事件代理构建事件状态，并在有效本地配对后按发行人内与跨公司汇总形成后继关系。在2024至2026年纳斯达克100与恒生指数日度面板上，作者报告其在四个预测指标与四个组合指标上表现最强，ICIR超过最强基线两倍以上，美国与香港净夏普分别为1.656与1.725；美国消融显示移除主要组件后IC与RankIC在Holm校正后显著下降。
cards.whyItMatters: 若历史事件延续在时点合规与可靠性校准后确实提供增量信息，则LLM金融代理可更系统地利用发行人特定事件时间结构，而不只是检索新闻文本；残差修正方式也有助于把历史事件信号与现有预测信号区分开来。

cards.originalTitle: Taming the Greeks: Option Portfolios with Inductive Biases
cards.whyItMattersEn: If the method is reproducible across broader markets and strategies, it would imply that neural network options trading strategies can directly control portfolio risk sensitivities during training rather than through post-hoc adjustments, potentially changing how return optimization and risk constraints are integrated in quantitative strategies.
cards.summaryEn: The authors propose a general training objective that combines a performance-driven loss with a differentiable risk-sensitivity penalty, enforcing neutrality to selected risk dimensions. The framework is instantiated on static delta-neutral straddle portfolios, with the penalty targeting first-order directional exposure, and two variants are compared: an exposure-normalized penalty and a Greek-ratio drift penalty. Empirical results on Nasdaq 100 equity options show that appropriately calibrated regularization simultaneously improves out-of-sample risk-adjusted performance and reduces realized directional exposure; however, these findings are limited to this specific market and strategy setting and do not constitute investment advice.
cards.limitations: 证据仅来自纳斯达克100股票期权上的静态delta中性跨式组合实例，且仅针对一阶方向性敞口；惩罚项校准依赖具体设定，样本外表现改善与方向性敞口降低均为该实验条件下的结果，未证明可推广至其他标的、期权策略、风险维度或市场环境。所有结论均为学术研究性质，不构成投资建议或策略推荐。
cards.descriptionEn: This study proposes an end-to-end deep learning framework that embeds portfolio-level risk exposure control directly into the training objective, rather than approximating optimal hedging policies via reinforcement learning on simulated market dynamics. Its novelty lies in replacing unconstrained optimization with a differentiable risk-sensitivity penalty, enabling the network to optimize risk-adjusted returns while explicitly constraining specific risk dimensions. This offer
cards.description: 该研究提出一种端到端深度学习框架，将组合层风险敞口控制直接嵌入训练目标，而非依赖强化学习的模拟市场动态近似。其新意在于用可微分风险敏感度惩罚项替代传统无约束优化，使神经网络在优化风险调整收益的同时显式约束特定风险维度。这为系统性期权交易提供了一条仅依赖历史数据、同时优化收益与风险约束的新路径，对量化策略开发者具有方法参考价值。
keyPointsEn: The framework operates entirely on historical data, jointly optimizing risk-adjusted returns and targeted risk constraints in a single learning problem, unlike reinforcement learning methods that approximate optimal hedging policies via simulated market dynamics.

It is instantiated on static delta-neutral straddle portfolios, with the penalty directed at first-order directional exposure, and compares two penalty variants: an exposure-normalized penalty and a Greek-ratio drift penalty.

Empirical results on Nasdaq 100 equity options indicate that appropriately calibrated regularization can simultaneously improve out-of-sample risk-adjusted performance and reduce realized directional exposure relative to an unregularized baseline.
cards.titleEn: End-to-End Deep Learning for Option Portfolios via Differentiable Risk-Sensitivity Penalties
cards.limitationsEn: The evidence comes only from a static delta-neutral straddle portfolio instance on Nasdaq 100 equity options and targets only first-order directional exposure; penalty calibration depends on the specific setup, and the improvements in out-of-sample performance and reductions in directional exposure are results under this experimental condition, with no proof of generalization to other underlyings, option strategies, risk dimensions, or market environments. All conclusions are academic research in nature and do not constitute investment advice or strategy recommendations.
keyPoints: 框架完全基于历史数据运行，在单一学习问题中联合优化风险调整收益与目标风险约束，区别于通过模拟市场动态近似最优对冲策略的强化学习方法。
以静态delta中性跨式组合为实例，惩罚项针对一阶方向性敞口，并对比了敞口归一化惩罚与希腊字母比率漂移惩罚两种变体。
纳斯达克100股票期权实证表明，适当校准的正则化可同时改善样本外风险调整表现并降低实际方向性敞口，相对于无正则化基线。
cards.title: 通过可微分风险敏感度惩罚实现期权组合的端到端深度学习交易
cards.summary: 作者提出一种通用训练目标，将绩效驱动损失与可微分风险敏感度惩罚相结合，强制模型对选定风险维度保持中性。框架在静态delta中性跨式组合上实例化，惩罚项针对一阶方向性敞口，并比较了敞口归一化惩罚与希腊字母比率漂移惩罚两种变体。基于纳斯达克100股票期权的实证结果显示，适当校准的正则化在改善样本外风险调整表现的同时降低了实际方向性敞口；但上述结论限于该特定市场与策略设定，不构成任何投资建议。
cards.whyItMatters: 若该方法在更广泛市场与策略上可复现，则意味着神经网络期权交易策略可以在训练阶段直接控制组合风险敏感度，而非事后调整，这可能改变量化策略中收益优化与风险约束的整合方式。

cards.originalTitle: Deep Reinforcement Learning for Equity Trading: Benchmarking Actor-Critic Methods with Forward Retraining
cards.whyItMattersEn: For quantitative research, the benchmark's value is that it places algorithm choice, retraining strategy, and risk exposure within one experimental framework, suggesting that the higher returns of end-to-end DRL may come with higher market beta, while forecast-driven strategies carry lower risk, implying a trade-off.
cards.summaryEn: Using daily data for 20 large-cap S&P 500 stocks from 2000 to 2020, the study benchmarks A2C, PPO, DDPG, TD3, and SAC against a supervised price-forecasting baseline, training on 2000-2018 and backtesting on 2019-2020, with an additional forward-retraining setting that retrains on all data available before each test window. It reports that DDPG achieves the highest annual return, Sharpe ratio, and alpha but also the highest market beta, while TD3 and SAC offer a better risk-return balance. The authors argue that forward retraining improves A2C, PPO, and SAC, leaves TD3 essentially unchanged, and substantially reduces DDPG's return, consistent with TD3 being more robust to hyperparameters.
cards.limitations: 结论仅基于2000—2020年20只标普500大盘股日频数据、特定技术指标与log min-max缩放，回测期2019—2020年样本外窗口较短，未覆盖交易成本、滑点、流动性和容量约束；前向重训的改善机制与TD3稳健性解释属于作者推断，并非因果结论；报告中的收益、夏普比率、alpha和回撤均为历史回测结果，不代表未来表现。
cards.descriptionEn: This study compares five actor-critic deep reinforcement learning trading methods with a supervised price-forecasting baseline under a shared data and backtesting protocol, and treats forward retraining as an explicit experimental variable. Its usefulness lies in showing how forward retraining affects return and risk differently across algorithms, rather than simply claiming DRL superiority.
cards.description: 该研究在相同数据与回测协议下，系统比较五种深度强化学习Actor-Critic交易方法与一个监督价格预测基线，并首次把“前向重训”作为独立变量检验。其有用性在于揭示前向重训对不同算法收益与风险的差异化影响，而非简单宣称DRL优于基线。
keyPointsEn: Under a shared backtesting protocol, DDPG achieves the highest annual return (55.5%), Sharpe ratio (1.38), and alpha (0.22), but also the highest market beta (1.24).

TD3 and SAC offer a better risk-return balance, with Sharpe ratios of 1.37 and 1.33 and maximum drawdowns of about 25%; the supervised forecasting baseline has the smallest maximum drawdown (9.6%) and the lowest beta (0.31).
Forward retraining improves A2C, PPO, and SAC, leaves TD3 essentially unchanged, and reduces DDPG's annual return from 55.5% to 29.8%.
cards.titleEn: Benchmarking Actor-Critic Deep Reinforcement Learning for Equity Trading with Forward Retraining
cards.limitationsEn: Conclusions are based only on daily data for 20 large-cap S&P 500 stocks from 2000 to 2020, specific technical indicators, and log min-max scaling; the out-of-sample backtest window of 2019-2020 is short, and transaction costs, slippage, liquidity, and capacity constraints are not covered. The mechanisms behind forward retraining's improvements and the interpretation of TD3's robustness are author inferences, not causal conclusions. The reported returns, Sharpe ratios, alpha, and drawdowns are historical backtest results and do not represent future performance.
keyPoints: 在统一回测协议下，DDPG取得最高年度收益55.5%、夏普比率1.38和alpha 0.22，但市场beta也最高，为1.24。
TD3与SAC提供更好的风险—收益平衡，夏普比率分别为1.37和1.33，最大回撤约25%；监督预测基线最大回撤最小，为9.6%，beta最低，为0.31。
前向重训改善A2C、PPO和SAC，对TD3基本无影响，并将DDPG年度收益从55.5%降至29.8%。
cards.title: 深度强化学习选股基准测试：前向重训与前向重训对Actor-Critic方法的影响
cards.summary: 研究使用2000—2020年20只标普500大盘股日频数据，比较A2C、PPO、DDPG、TD3、SAC与监督价格预测基线，训练期为2000—2018年，回测期为2019—2020年，并额外考察每轮测试前用全部可得数据重训的前向重训设置。报告显示DDPG年度收益、夏普比率和alpha最高，但市场beta也最高；TD3与SAC在风险—收益上更均衡。作者观点认为前向重训改善A2C、PPO和SAC，对TD3基本无影响，并显著降低DDPG收益，这与TD3对超参数更稳健的解释一致。
cards.whyItMatters: 对量化研究而言，该基准的价值在于把算法选择、重训策略与风险暴露放在同一实验框架中比较，提示端到端DRL的高收益可能伴随更高市场beta，而预测驱动策略风险更低，二者存在取舍。

cards.originalTitle: Retrieval-Augmented Diffusion Modeling for Stochastic Discount Factor Portfolios
cards.whyItMattersEn: If reproducible, the method offers a way to explicitly model state-dependent uncertainty in SDF portfolio optimization, potentially learning more conditional market representations in non-stationary markets and improving risk-adjusted portfolio performance.
cards.summaryEn: The authors study portfolio optimization under the stochastic discount factor framework and identify challenges including non-stationary market dynamics, noisy multimodal inputs, and existing diffusion methods' reliance on isotropic Gaussian noise assumptions. They propose RADAR, which uses retrieval of similar historical regimes to construct context-dependent noise distributions and applies conditional diffusion to denoise multimodal representations. Experiments report that RADAR achieves state-of-the-art performance on key risk-adjusted metrics and produces economically meaningful signals on asset returns and correlations.
cards.limitations: 输入仅提供摘要性描述，未给出实验细节、基准、样本区间、统计显著性及交易成本等关键信息。结论基于作者报告，未经独立复现；方法对检索质量、历史状态定义与多模态数据质量敏感，其在真实投资场景中的稳健性与可实施性尚不明确。
cards.descriptionEn: The work introduces RADAR, a retrieval-augmented diffusion framework that learns market state representations and constructs context-dependent noise distributions to capture state-dependent financial uncertainty. Its novelty lies in relaxing the isotropic Gaussian noise assumption and initializing diffusion with empirical statistics; it is potentially useful for SDF portfolio optimization.
cards.description: 该工作提出RADAR，用检索增强的扩散框架学习市场状态表示，以条件化噪声分布刻画状态依赖的金融不确定性。其新意在于突破传统各向同性高斯噪声假设，并利用历史相似状态初始化扩散过程；对SDF组合优化有潜在价值。
keyPointsEn: RADAR combines retrieval augmentation with conditional diffusion, using similar historical regimes to construct state-dependent noise distributions rather than assuming isotropic Gaussian noise.
The method initializes the diffusion process with empirical statistics and denoises multimodal representations such as price and news data to learn market state representations.
Experiments report state-of-the-art risk-adjusted metrics and economically meaningful signals on asset returns and correlations.
cards.titleEn: Retrieval-Augmented Diffusion Modeling for Stochastic Discount Factor Portfolios
cards.limitationsEn: The input provides only an abstract-level description, lacking experimental details, benchmarks, sample periods, statistical significance, and transaction costs. The conclusions are author-reported and not independently replicated; the method is sensitive to retrieval quality, historical regime definitions, and multimodal data quality, and its robustness and implementability in real investment settings remain unclear.
keyPoints: RADAR将检索增强与条件扩散结合，以历史相似状态构建状态依赖的噪声分布，不再假设各向同性高斯噪声。
方法用经验统计初始化扩散过程，并对价格与新闻等多模态表示进行去噪，以学习市场状态表示。
实验报告在风险调整指标上达到最优，并产生关于资产收益与相关性的经济信号。
cards.title: 检索增强扩散模型学习随机折现因子组合
cards.summary: 作者研究随机折现因子框架下的组合优化，指出金融市场非平稳、多模态数据含噪、现有扩散方法依赖各向同性高斯噪声假设等问题。他们提出RADAR，通过检索相似历史状态构建上下文相关的噪声分布，并对多模态表示进行条件扩散去噪。实验报告称RADAR在关键风险调整指标上取得最优表现，并产生具有经济含义的资产收益与相关性信号。
cards.whyItMatters: 若该方法可复现，它为SDF组合优化提供了一种显式建模状态依赖不确定性的途径，有助于在非平稳市场中学习更具条件性的市场表示，并可能改善风险调整后的组合表现。

cards.originalTitle: SERL-SQL: Selective Hindsight Distillation for Text-to-SQL Reinforcement Agentic Learning
cards.whyItMattersEn: The method refines execution correctness from a trajectory-level reward into token-level credit assignment, which can help multi-turn Text-to-SQL agents pinpoint critical SQL decisions; its reward-based selection approaching the upper bound also offers a reproducible reference for filtering candidates with lightweight execution rewards.
cards.summaryEn: Fact: SERL-SQL is a selective, execution-grounded reinforcement learning framework for multi-turn Text-to-SQL agents; it uses a training-only teacher to re-score student actions with execution feedback and converts the teacher-student likelihood gap into bounded, masked weights that reweight GRPO advantages only on SQL and tool-action tokens. Fact: it reaches 76.56% execution accuracy on BIRD-Dev and 89.92% on Spider-Test, and its reward-based selection closely approaches the oracle Best-of-N upper bound and outperforms consistency-based selection. Author view: this preserves the task-reward optimization direction while using execution hindsight for localized credit assignment, producing high-quality candidates that lightweight execution-grounded rewards can reliably identify.
cards.limitations: 证据边界：结果来自论文自报的BIRD、Spider及跨域基准，尚不构成对所有数据库、方言或真实生产环境的泛化保证；教师模型仅在训练期使用，其质量与重评方式对效果的影响未在输入中给出消融细节；代码尚未发布，无法独立复现；执行准确率不直接等同于业务正确性或安全性，不构成投资或部署建议。
cards.descriptionEn: The work notes that most Text-to-SQL reinforcement learning methods use execution correctness only as a trajectory-level reward, which gives limited guidance for identifying which SQL decisions cause success or failure. SERL-SQL samples on-policy trajectories and uses a training-only teacher to re-score student actions with execution feedback; the teacher-student likelihood gap becomes bounded, masked weights that reweight GRPO advantages only on SQL and tool-action tokens, e
cards.description: 该工作指出多数Text-to-SQL强化学习方法仅用执行正确性作为轨迹级奖励，难以定位具体SQL决策的成败责任。SERL-SQL通过训练专用教师模型结合执行反馈重评学生动作，将师生似然差转为有界掩码权重，仅对SQL与工具动作token重加权GRPO优势，实现局部信用分配。实验在BIRD、Spider及跨域基准上取得竞争性结果，其奖励选择策略接近oracle Best-of-N上界并优于一致性选择。
keyPointsEn: A training-only teacher re-scores student actions with execution feedback; the teacher-student likelihood gap becomes bounded, masked weights that reweight GRPO advantages only on SQL and tool-action tokens.
It achieves 76.56% execution accuracy on BIRD-Dev and 89.92% on Spider-Test, with competitive performance on cross-domain benchmarks.
Its reward-based selection strategy closely approaches the oracle Best-of-N upper bound and consistently outperforms consistency-based selection.
cards.titleEn: SERL-SQL: Selective Hindsight Distillation for Multi-Turn Text-to-SQL Agents
cards.limitationsEn: Evidence boundary: results are self-reported on BIRD, Spider, and cross-domain benchmarks and do not guarantee generalization to all databases, dialects, or real production settings; the teacher model is used only during training, and the input provides no ablation details on how teacher quality or re-scoring choices affect outcomes; code is not yet released, so independent reproduction is not possible; execution accuracy does not directly equal business correctness or safety, and this is not investment or deployment advice.
keyPoints: 训练专用教师用执行反馈重评学生动作，师生似然差转为有界掩码权重，仅重加权SQL与工具动作token的GRPO优势。
在BIRD-Dev达76.56%执行准确率、Spider-Test达89.92%，跨域基准表现竞争性。
奖励选择策略接近oracle Best-of-N上界，并持续优于一致性选择。
cards.title: SERL-SQL：选择性后见蒸馏提升多轮Text-to-SQL智能体
cards.summary: 事实：SERL-SQL是一个选择性、以执行为基础的多轮Text-to-SQL强化学习框架，用训练专用教师模型结合执行反馈重评学生动作，将师生似然差转换为有界掩码权重，仅对SQL和工具动作token重加权GRPO优势。事实：在BIRD-Dev达76.56%执行准确率、Spider-Test达89.92%，奖励选择策略接近oracle Best-of-N上界并优于一致性选择。作者观点：该方法能在保留任务奖励优化方向的同时，利用执行后见实现局部信用分配，产生可被轻量奖励可靠识别的高质量候选。
cards.whyItMatters: 该方法把执行正确性从轨迹级奖励细化为token级信用分配，有助于多轮Text-to-SQL智能体定位关键SQL决策；其奖励选择接近上界的结果，也为轻量执行奖励筛选候选提供了可复现的参考。

cards.originalTitle: AQuA: Recursively Self-Improving Quantitative Trading Research Agents
cards.whyItMattersEn: This work advances recursive self-improvement from general tasks into the quantitative research process, emphasizing the use of historical experimental evidence to constrain subsequent hypothesis generation rather than letting the model search freely. For automating quantitative research, it offers a design pattern of a fixed evaluator and constrained action space, useful for discussing reproducibility, overfitting risk, and the boundaries of strategy evaluation.
cards.summaryEn: The paper studies recursive self-improvement at the level of quantitative-investment research: whether an autonomous system can use evidence from earlier experiments to improve later hypotheses and candidates. AQuA contains two separate language-model-driven research systems, one for symbolic factor discovery and one for trainable model development, each recording experimental results to guide subsequent proposals. The factor system, a manager-mediated multi-agent pipeline, reaches a combined validation information coefficient of about 0.190 on a crypto universe; the model system, a config-driven loop over a hybrid time-series architecture, reaches a per-stock information coefficient of +0.0843 on US equities and converts it into a threshold long/short strategy with a held-out Sharpe of up to +2.50 at a two-leg cost. The authors report the strategy is positive in every year from 2021 to 2025.
cards.limitations: 结果来自论文定义的固定沙盒、数据划分和评估器，不能直接外推到其他市场、资产或交易成本假设。加密因子与美股模型的指标是特定实验设置下的验证结果，留出样本夏普最高 +2.50 与逐年为正的结论依赖所述双腿成本假设，未说明更大容量、滑点、冲击或制度变化下的表现。系统在固定特征和标签定义下运行，其递归改进是否在沙盒外保持稳定，论文摘要未提供证据。
cards.descriptionEn: The study presents AQuA, comprising two language-model-driven research systems for symbolic factor discovery and trainable model development, which record experimental results to guide subsequent proposals. Its novelty lies in constraining recursive self-improvement within a fixed sandbox where the model acts only through constrained factor expressions or configuration diffs; its usefulness is in providing reproducible factor and US-equity strategy validation results with rep
cards.description: 该研究提出 AQuA，用两个语言模型驱动的研究系统分别负责符号因子发现与可训练模型开发，并让系统记录实验结果来引导后续提案。其新意在于把递归自我改进限制在固定沙盒中，只允许模型通过受限因子表达式或配置差分行动；有用之处在于给出可复现的因子与美股策略验证结果，并公开了信息系数与回测表现。
keyPointsEn: AQuA runs two language-model-driven systems within a fixed sandbox that fixes data splits, feature and label definitions, and the evaluator, allowing the model to act only through constrained factor expressions or configuration diffs.
The factor discovery system is a manager-mediated multi-agent pipeline that achieves a combined validation information coefficient of about 0.190 on a crypto universe.

The model system is a config-driven loop over a hybrid time-series architecture that achieves a per-stock information coefficient of +0.0843 on US equities and converts it into a threshold long/short strategy with a held-out Sharpe of up to +2.50.
cards.titleEn: AQuA: Recursively Self-Improving Quantitative Trading Research Agents
cards.limitationsEn: The results come from the paper's fixed sandbox, data splits, and evaluator, and cannot be directly extrapolated to other markets, assets, or trading-cost assumptions. The crypto factor and US-equity model metrics are validation results under specific experimental settings; the held-out Sharpe of up to +2.50 and the every-year-positive conclusion depend on the stated two-leg cost assumption, with no evidence on larger capacity, slippage, impact, or regime changes. The system operates under fixed feature and label definitions, and the abstract does not provide evidence on whether its recursive improvement remains stable outside the sandbox.
keyPoints: AQuA 在固定沙盒中运行两个语言模型驱动系统，只允许通过受限因子表达式或配置差分行动，数据划分、特征标签和评估器均固定。
因子发现系统为经理中介的多智能体流水线，在加密资产上达到约 0.190 的组合验证信息系数。
模型系统为配置驱动的混合时序架构循环，在美股上达到每股 +0.0843 的信息系数，并转化为留出样本夏普最高 +2.50 的阈值多空策略。
cards.title: AQuA 让量化研究智能体递归自我改进
cards.summary: 论文研究量化投资研究层面的递归自我改进：自主系统能否用早期实验证据改进后续假设与候选。AQuA 包含两个独立的语言模型驱动研究系统，分别用于符号因子发现和可训练模型开发，二者都记录实验结果并用于指导后续提案。因子系统为经理中介的多智能体流水线，在加密资产上取得约 0.190 的组合验证信息系数；模型系统为配置驱动的混合时序架构循环，在美股上取得每股 +0.0843 的信息系数，并转化为阈值多空策略，在双腿成本下留出样本夏普最高达 +2.50。作者报告该策略在 2021 至 2025 年每年均为正。
cards.whyItMatters: 该工作把递归自我改进从通用任务推进到量化研究流程，强调用历史实验证据约束后续假设生成，而非让模型自由搜索。对量化研究自动化而言，它提供了固定评估器与受限行动空间的设计思路，有助于讨论可复现性、过拟合风险和策略评价边界。

cards.whyItMattersEn: These changes make TradingAgents easier to integrate into automated pipelines, improve analyst-phase efficiency, and make each run's parameters traceable; for integrators relying on old interfaces, incompatible changes must be handled per the notes before upgrading.
cards.summaryEn: The main changes in TradingAgents v0.5.2 are that analysts can run concurrently, the command line supports unattended execution, reports record generation parameters, and a Docker data folder and analyst tool-call cap are added. The release notes also list minimum dependency versions for upgrading, a change in default data source order, and multiple API renames. Fixes include data tools always using the run's instrument, vendor failures being classified as unavailable, and ratings being read only from the Portfolio Manager label. The above is a restatement of the release notes, without independent verification of actual effects.
cards.limitations: 以上内容基于发布说明，未经过独立功能或性能验证；并行调度、无人值守运行、报告溯源和工具调用上限的实际收益与稳定性需以实际环境测试为准；不构成投资建议或对回测结果的保证。
cards.descriptionEn: The open-source framework TradingAgents released v0.5.2, adding parallel analyst scheduling, unattended CLI runs, and report provenance records, plus fixes for data requests and rating parsing, along with breaking changes requiring Python 3.11 or later.
cards.description: 开源框架 TradingAgents 发布 v0.5.2，新增并行分析师调度、无人值守命令行运行和报告溯源记录，并修复数据请求与评级解析问题，同时引入多项破坏性变更，要求 Python 3.11 及以上。
keyPointsEn: Parallel analysts make the analyst phase take about as long as the slowest one, with the CLI showing each analyst's progress and the debate starting after all finish.
Unattended runs complete all interactions via command-line flags and TRADINGAGENTS_* environment variables, stopping before start with a message if required answers are missing.
Reports begin with analysis date, version, provider, models, analysts, rounds, and data vendors, saved as run_settings in the state log.
cards.titleEn: TradingAgents v0.5.2: Parallel Analysts and Unattended CLI Runs
cards.limitationsEn: The above is based on release notes and has not been independently verified for functionality or performance; the actual benefits and stability of parallel scheduling, unattended runs, report provenance, and tool-call caps require testing in real environments; it does not constitute investment advice or a guarantee of backtest results.
keyPoints: 并行分析师使分析师阶段耗时接近最慢单个分析师，CLI 展示各分析师进度，全部完成后开始辩论。
无人值守运行可通过命令行标志和 TRADINGAGENTS_* 环境变量完成所有交互，缺少必要答案时在开始前终止并提示。
报告开头记录分析日期、版本、提供方、模型、分析师、轮数和数据供应商，状态日志保存为 run_settings。
cards.title: TradingAgents v0.5.2：并行分析师与非交互式命令行运行
cards.summary: TradingAgents v0.5.2 的主要变化是分析师可同时运行、命令行支持无人值守执行、报告中记录生成参数，并加入 Docker 数据目录和分析师工具调用上限。发布说明还列出该版本升级所需的依赖最低版本、数据源默认顺序调整以及多项 API 重命名。修复内容包括数据工具始终采用运行标的、供应商失败归类为不可用，以及评级只读取 Portfolio Manager 标签。以上为发布说明转述，未对实际效果做独立验证。
cards.whyItMatters: 这些变更让 TradingAgents 更易于纳入自动化流程，提高分析师阶段效率，并使每次运行的参数可追溯；对依赖旧接口的集成方，升级前需按说明处理不兼容变更。

cards.originalTitle: Robot Manipulation with GPT-6-Astra: Body Knowledge, Experience Reuse, Emergent Skills, and Sim2Real Transfer
cards.whyItMattersEn: This work offers an actionable path for using general-purpose multimodal agents in robot manipulation: by providing machine-readable body descriptions, synchronized demonstrations, and solidifying agent-generated feedback routines into reusable skills, it improves execution efficiency and mitigates slowness from repeated exploration and model-mediated action selection.
cards.summaryEn: In fixed-start simulation trials, complete geometry and camera information reduced mean completion time by 57.4%, and synchronized action-state images reduced it by 68.6%; in paired trials displaced by 10–100 cm, experience from the original start reduced mean time by 58–63%. GPT-6-Astra spontaneously generated a short visual-feedback program during experience experiments, and researcher-refactored versions reduced mean local-task time by 29–31% across 27 simulation trials. In 12 real-robot trials, simulation XML assets and simulation experience reduced mean time by 53.0% and 49.9% respectively, and real experience also transferred to two new starts. The authors suggest that supplying machine-readable body descriptions, synchronized demonstrations, and converting agent-generated feedback routines into reusable skills is a practical way to build general-purpose manipulation experiments.
cards.limitations: 证据来自仿真与单一真实升降按钮任务，固定起点仿真为 30 次试验，位移比较为 9 对共 18 次试验，真实机器人仅 12 次试验且按钮接触由操作员确认。经验泛化仅测试了 10–100 cm 的新起点，未涵盖更广泛任务、物体、环境或机器人形态。摘要未报告失败率、安全性、长时程稳定性及统计检验细节，因此结论的外推需谨慎。
cards.descriptionEn: This study tests GPT-6-Astra controlling an XLeRobot in simulated and physical elevator-button tasks, finding that complete body knowledge, synchronized demonstrations, and reusable skills significantly shorten task completion time and provide preliminary evidence of sim2real transfer.
cards.description: 该研究在仿真与真实电梯按钮任务中测试 GPT-6-Astra 控制 XLeRobot 的效果，发现提供完整机器人几何与相机信息、同步动作状态记录及可复用技能后，任务完成时间显著缩短，并初步验证仿真资产与经验向真实机器人的迁移。
keyPointsEn: Complete robot geometry and camera information reduce mean completion time by 57.4% in fixed-start simulation, while synchronized action and state images reduce it by 68.6%.
In 18 paired trials with starts displaced by 10–100 cm, experience from the original start reduces mean time by 58–63%.
In 12 real-robot trials, simulation XML assets and simulation experience reduce mean time by 53.0% and 49.9%, and real experience transfers to two new starts.
cards.titleEn: Robot Manipulation with GPT-6-Astra: Body Knowledge, Experience Reuse, and Sim2Real Transfer
cards.limitationsEn: Evidence comes from simulation and a single physical elevator-button task, with 30 fixed-start simulation trials, 9 paired comparisons (18 trials) for displacement, and only 12 real-robot trials where button contact was operator-confirmed. Experience generalization was tested only at new starts of 10–100 cm, not across broader tasks, objects, environments, or robot morphologies. The abstract does not report failure rates, safety, long-horizon stability, or statistical test details, so extrapolation should be cautious.
keyPoints: 完整机器人几何与相机信息使固定起点仿真任务平均完成时间降低 57.4%，同步动作与状态图像降低 68.6%。
在起点偏移 10–100 cm 的 18 次成对试验中，原起点经验使平均时间降低 58–63%。
12 次真实机器人试验中，仿真 XML 资产与仿真经验分别使平均时间降低 53.0% 和 49.9%，真实经验迁移到两个新起点。
cards.title: GPT-6-Astra 机器人操控：身体知识、经验复用与仿真到现实迁移
cards.summary: 研究在固定起点仿真试验中，完整几何与相机信息使平均完成时间降低 57.4%，同步动作与状态图像降低 68.6%；在偏移 10–100 cm 的成对试验中，原起点经验使平均时间降低 58–63%。GPT-6-Astra 在经验实验中自发生成短视觉反馈程序，经研究者重构后在 27 次仿真试验中使局部任务平均时间降低 29–31%。12 次真实机器人试验中，仿真 XML 资产与仿真经验分别使平均时间降低 53.0% 和 49.9%，真实经验也迁移到两个新起点。作者认为，提供机器可读身体描述、同步演示并将智能体生成的反馈例程转化为可复用技能，是构建通用操控实验的实用方式。
cards.whyItMatters: 该工作为利用通用多模态智能体进行机器人操控提供了一种可操作路径：通过机器可读的身体描述、同步演示和将智能体自发产生的反馈例程固化为可复用技能，提升执行效率并缓解重复探索与模型中介动作选择带来的缓慢问题。

cards.originalTitle: The Data Engineering Professional Certificate is now on DeepLearning.AI
cards.whyItMattersEn: Data underlies all modern AI systems, and engineers who can build systems that store and serve data are in high demand. The program organizes the full chain from data generation to serving, and from batch to streaming processing, into structured learning, and emphasizes implementing modern data architectures with open-source tools. This can help learners understand how data supports analytics and machine learning.
cards.summaryEn: DeepLearning.AI announced that its Data Engineering Professional Certificate is now available, a four-course program designed to make learners job-ready for data engineering. The courses cover data engineering lifecycle stages, including data generation, ingestion, storage, transformation and serving, and implement modern data architectures using open-source tools. Learners also build batch and streaming pipelines, orchestrate, automate and monitor data flow, and model, transform and serve data for analytics and machine learning.
cards.limitations: 该信息来自 DeepLearning.AI 的课程发布介绍，属于课程提供方的宣传材料，未提供独立的第三方评估、课程效果数据或学员就业结果。课程是否真正带来就业竞争力、具体教学质量和工具深度，均无法仅凭该介绍判断。原始内容也没有给出费用、先修要求、课时和考核方式等细节。
cards.descriptionEn: Released by DeepLearning.AI, this is a four-course professional certificate aimed at preparing learners with foundational data engineering skills. Its novelty lies in covering the full data engineering lifecycle with open-source tools—from generating, ingesting, storing and transforming data to serving it—rather than focusing on a single tool. For those entering data engineering or strengthening data infrastructure skills, it offers a structured learning path.
cards.description: 该课程由 DeepLearning.AI 发布，为四门课组成的职业证书项目，目标是让学习者具备数据工程岗位所需的基础技能。其新意在于围绕开源工具覆盖数据工程全生命周期，从生成、摄取、存储、转换到服务数据，而非只讲单一工具。对希望进入数据工程领域或补齐数据基础设施能力的人，它提供了成体系的学习路径。
keyPointsEn: The four-course Data Engineering Professional Certificate is now on DeepLearning.AI and is positioned as job-oriented training.
The program covers the data engineering lifecycle—generating, ingesting, storing, transforming and serving data—and uses open-source tools to implement modern data architectures.
Hands-on work includes building batch and streaming pipelines, orchestrating, automating and monitoring data flow, and serving data for analytics and machine learning.
cards.titleEn: DeepLearning.AI Launches Data Engineering Professional Certificate
cards.limitationsEn: This information comes from DeepLearning.AI's course launch announcement, which is promotional material from the provider and offers no independent third-party evaluation, course outcome data or learner employment results. Whether the program truly improves job prospects, along with instructional quality and depth of tool coverage, cannot be judged from this description alone. The original content also does not provide details such as cost, prerequisites, duration or assessment methods.
keyPoints: 四门课组成的数据工程职业证书已在 DeepLearning.AI 上线，定位为面向岗位的培训。
课程覆盖数据工程生命周期：生成、摄取、存储、转换、服务数据，并引入开源工具搭建现代数据架构。
实践内容包括构建批处理与流式管道，以及编排、自动化和监控数据流，并服务于分析与机器学习。
cards.title: DeepLearning.AI 推出数据工程职业证书课程
cards.summary: DeepLearning.AI 宣布数据工程职业证书课程上线，该项目为四门课组成，面向数据工程岗位准备。课程内容覆盖数据工程生命周期各阶段，包括数据生成、摄取、存储、转换与服务，并使用开源工具实现现代数据架构。学习者还会构建批处理与流式管道，并对数据流进行编排、自动化与监控，同时为分析与机器学习建模、转换和提供数据。
cards.whyItMatters: 数据是现代 AI 系统的基础，而能够构建存储与服务数据系统的工程师需求较高。该课程把数据工程从数据生成到服务、从批处理到流式处理的完整链路组织成体系化学习内容，并强调用开源工具实现现代数据架构，有助于学习者理解数据如何支撑分析与机器学习。

cards.whyItMattersEn: Autonomous AI agents often need to execute code, access files, or call external tools, making safety and privacy boundaries a prerequisite for deployment. A runtime layer that natively provides isolation and privacy could reduce the cost of building sandboxes and permission controls in-house; the repository's NVIDIA origin may also influence the agent infrastructure ecosystem. This value judgment rests on the project's positioning and still requires technical details and independent verification.
cards.summaryEn: Fact: the project comes from GitHub Trending Daily, the repository is NVIDIA/OpenShell, its one-line official description calls it a safe, private runtime for autonomous AI agents, and it was published on 2026-09-29. Author's view: the vendor positions it as a safety and privacy foundation layer for agent execution. Because the input contains only one summary sentence, there are no technical details, architecture notes, or measured results to assess its actual capabilities.
cards.limitations: 本卡仅依据 GitHub Trending Daily 中一句官方摘要生成，未获取仓库 README、代码、许可、版本状态或任何基准测试结果。因此无法确认其安全模型、隐私保护机制、支持的代理框架、部署环境、性能开销与成熟度。官方“安全、私密”的表述属于项目自我定位，而非独立验证的结论；也不构成对采用该项目的建议。
cards.descriptionEn: OpenShell is an NVIDIA project surfaced on GitHub Trending, positioned as a safe and private runtime for autonomous AI agents. Its novelty lies in treating runtime safety and privacy as an infrastructure layer for agents rather than an afterthought; it is directly relevant to teams that let agents execute code or call tools.
cards.description: OpenShell 是 NVIDIA 在 GitHub Trending 上公开的项目，定位为自主 AI 代理的安全、私密运行时。其新意在于将运行时安全与隐私保护作为自主代理的基础设施层，而非事后附加；对需要让代理执行代码或调用工具的开发团队有直接参考价值。

The input provides no architecture, security mechanisms, supported platforms, or performance data.

cards.whyItMattersEn: If its claimed compatibility and lightweight features hold, developers might use a single tool to manage multiple databases and integrate with automation workflows via built-in AI or MCP interfaces; however, this is currently based only on the project's self-description and actual effectiveness cannot yet be confirmed.

There is currently no third-party evaluation or long-term usage evidence to verify its compatibility and stability.

cards.whyItMattersEn: As coding agents such as Claude Code and Codex proliferate, making different agents collaborate on complex tasks is a practical engineering problem. OpenRig offers an approach to combining two mainstream agents into one system, providing a reference for exploring multi-agent workflows.
cards.summaryEn: OpenRig is a multi-agent harness trending on GitHub that focuses on running Claude Code and Codex as one combined system. It does not involve model training or new benchmarks, but centers on agent orchestration and tool integration. Its practical reliability still needs verification through the repository's documentation and code.
cards.limitations: 目前仅有 GitHub 项目标题与一句简介，没有文档、评测或代码细节来证明其协同效果。不清楚支持的任务类型、延迟、成本、冲突处理机制与可复现性。不应据此推断其优于单一代理或已可用于生产。
cards.descriptionEn: OpenRig is a multi-agent harness that aims to make Claude Code and Codex work together as a single system. Its novelty lies in a unified orchestration layer for two heterogeneous coding agents, offering a practical starting point for hybrid agent workflows.
cards.description: OpenRig 是一个多智能体运行框架，旨在让 Claude Code 和 Codex 作为统一系统协同工作。新意在于用统一编排层管理两个异构编码代理，为构建混合代理工作流提供实践起点。
keyPointsEn: Positioned as a multi-agent harness that brings Claude Code and Codex into a unified runtime.
Core focus is collaboration and orchestration between heterogeneous coding agents, not single-model capability.
Comes from GitHub Trending and is an engineering-practice project.
cards.titleEn: OpenRig: Running Claude Code and Codex Together as One Multi-Agent System
cards.limitationsEn: Only a GitHub project title and a one-line description are available; there is no documentation, evaluation, or code detail to prove its collaborative effectiveness. Task types supported, latency, cost, conflict-handling mechanisms, and reproducibility are unclear. It should not be inferred to outperform a single agent or be production-ready.
